# threejs (pointer)

This repository does not redistribute threejs. Nothing from it is present here.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- Fetch it locally: `node tools/fetch-upstream.mjs --slug threejs --yes`
- Its license and terms are the upstream project's; do not assume this project's MIT license applies.

Why it is a pointer: the material either carries no redistribution grant or its
license could not be established, so shipping a copy here would be a license
violation. Fetching it on demand keeps this repository clean.
